speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: Suction bucket foundations can substantially reduce the underwater noise produced during construction.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: From the perspective of marine biodiversity, this is the more promising option.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: There is, however, limited long-term experience with this technology in large offshore wind projects.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: The uncertainty creates additional technical and financial risks for the project.

speaker: ENERGY MINISTER
text: We may therefore need additional insurance and contingency funding to account for these risks.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: Scientific uncertainty does not mean that we should ignore a technology that could substantially reduce harm to marine life.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Suction buckets provide strong potential benefits for SDG 14, but their experimental nature creates additional project risk.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: Construction plans have now been finalized.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: We will now assess how well the selected mitigation measures balance environmental protection, economic interests and international obligations.
